notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. Warnings: G4.REF_VALUE for the head joint range: the clone writes MIN_HEAD_ANGLE/MAX_HEAD_ANGLE as util.degrees(-25)/util.degrees(44.5) (src/cozmo/robot.py:99, 102), and G4 evaluates math.radians(...) but not util.degrees(...), so it cannot see the radian values the Limit holds (-0.43633..0.77667 rad); the cited lines are the ones that state the bound. Scope: the card lists five entry symbols and this package implements only cozmo.robot:Robot; cozmo.camera:Camera, cozmo.world:World, cozmo.nav_memory_map:NavMemoryMapGrid and cozmo.annotate:ImageAnnotator are not covered, and no camera image or other array output is exposed. The robot's wheels are not driven: the package moves the head joint (cap.motion.joint_position.v1) and the lift (an extension action), reads five states and stops every motor; cap.motion.stop.v1 is not bound because it declares a deceleration profile the abrupt native stop cannot honour. The hardware path (native.py, the Cozmo engine connection over USB/TCP and the SDK event loop) was never run, and the fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording of a robot. RESULT.json is written last; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
